major_issues: 报告标题和核心问题（方法论章节与摘要结论的引用权重差异）与证据集内容严重脱节。证据集中的文献主要讨论具体技术方法（如ABM、AI模型、多智能体系统等）的应用，并未涉及学术引用权重分配的理论或实践问题。
报告试图基于一个与核心问题无关的证据集得出结论。证据集中的8篇文献均未讨论或提供关于'方法论章节与摘要结论引用权重差异'的直接证据或观点，导致整个分析缺乏有效支撑。
报告第3节'证据支持的研究方向'中的三个论点（信息深度差异、功能定位不同、权重评估复杂性）是合理的学术观点，但均非来自证据集，而是作者自行推断，违反了'仅基于证据'的审查原则。
citation_issues: 所有对证据的引用（如[1][2][5][7][8]等）在报告中仅被用作说明'方法论描述'和'结论陈述'的示例，但并未被用来支持报告的核心论点（即权重差异问题）。这种引用方式属于事实误用，因为被引用的内容与报告论点无关。
报告声称'现有摘要证据支持以下值得深入探讨的研究方向'，但随后列出的方向并非从提供的证据中推导出来。例如，证据[5][7]仅描述了具体技术方法，并未讨论'信息深度差异对评估的影响'；证据[8]仅指出知识碎片化问题，并未关联到'权重评估的复杂性'。
报告结论中'依据引用目的的不同，对两者赋予不同程度的依赖和权重是合理且必要的'这一核心判断，在证据集中没有任何文献提供支持。

如果坚持原主题（引用权重差异），则必须明确指出：当前证据集无法为该问题提供直接证据，报告中的所有分析均为基于摘要信息的推测，并需删除所有暗示证据支持该论点的表述（如第3节开头的声明）。
所有引用必须严格用于支持与证据内容直接相关的论点。例如，引用[7]应用于说明多智能体技术如何用于数字孪生建模，而非用于论证方法论章节的细节重要性。
删除第3节中'证据支持的研究方向'的提法，或将其改为'基于摘要信息的观察与推测'，并明确说明这些推测缺乏证据支持。

top_papers.title: A Deep Q-Network for the Beer Game: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Inventory Optimization
top_papers.abstract: Problem definition: The beer game is widely used in supply chain management classes to demonstrate the bullwhip effect and the importance of supply chain coordination. The game is a decentralized, multiagent, cooperative problem that can be modeled as a serial supply chain network in which agents choose order quantities while cooperatively attempting to minimize the network’s total cost, although each agent only observes local information. Academic/practical relevance: Under some conditions, a base-stock replenishment policy is optimal. However, in a decentralized supply chain in which some agents act irrationally, there is no known optimal policy for an agent wishing to act optimally. top_papers.title: Development of models and methods for creating a digital twin of plant within the cyber-physical system for precision farming management
top_papers.abstract: Abstract The paper discusses creation of a digital twin (DT) of plant for an intelligent cyber-physical system for managing precision farming. A new approach to formalization of DT knowledge is proposed to form expert knowledge within the subject area based on the ontological specification of stages of plant growth and development and multi-agent technology for creating stage agents and coordinated dynamic recalculation of stage duration and yield forecast based on events in the environment. The paper proposes a method for calculating the forecast for duration of plant development stages and yield based on expert knowledge. top_papers.title: Anthropomorphism of Artificial Intelligence Service Agent and Consumer Responses: A Systematic Literature Review and Future Research Agenda
top_papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Artificial intelligence service agent (AISA) anthropomorphism is increasingly applied in service situations to deliver consumers a more personalized service experience. Extensive research has explored it over the past decade. However, the body of knowledge about this domain remains fragmented due to the lack of a comprehensive review. This paper aims to understand the domain through a framework‐based systematic literature review approach. We conducted an in‐depth analysis of 149 peer‐reviewed articles retrieved on April 25, 2024.
